### Operating Vendor
The vendor directly providing the digital marketing platform **Sendinblue** at the domain **sendinblue.com** (which rebranded to Brevo) is **Sendinblue SAS** (now officially operating as **Brevo SAS**, with **Sendinblue Inc.** serving customers in the United States, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand).

### Evidence and Provider Statement
The official Terms of Service state:
> *"Sendinblue, a simplified joint-stock company registered with the Paris Trade and Companies Register under number 498 019 298 with its registered office at 106 boulevard Haussmann 75008 Paris (hereafter “Brevo“) operates a solution relating to marketing and/or transactional email and/or SMS..."*
